title: GFG - Gender-Fair Generation: A CALAMITA Challenge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on three tasks across monolingual (Italian) and cross-lingual (English-Italian) scenarios: 1) detecting referentially gender-marked expressions (measured via BERTScore), 2) reformulating gendered expressions into gender-fair alternatives using obscuration or neomorphemes (measured via a gender-neutral classifier), and 3) generating gender-fair translations (measured via classifier accuracy and coverage-weighted accuracy).
